author: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
html:
[Ajaxian.com](http://ajaxian.com/archives/2005/12/firefox_15_java.html) has found an extension for Firefox 1.5 that lets you filter out CSS errors and JavaScript.

> I noticed that my JavaScript console started to spew out CSS errors in 1.5 land:
>
> [![javascript-console-highjack](http://ajaxian.com/archives/javascript-console-highjack.jpg)](http://forums.mozillazine.org/viewtopic.php?t=318102)
>
> Then I saw [information about](http://blog.dojotoolkit.org/2005/12/01/useful-tools-console2) [Console2](http://forums.mozillazine.org/viewtopic.php?t=318102) which gives you just JavaScript errors, and lets the CSS ones go by.

Great news, as I have a project at work, where we use Microsoft Sharepoint (with two standard Sharepoint CSS files). These files have lots of CSS errors, which makes it sometimes hard to find the JavaScript errors.
